title: Out
about: Phrasal verbs with out in its basic meanings (make someone leave, not include, stick out, choose, share) and in other common verbs: a fire going out, dropping out, lashing out at someone, sorting out a problem.

parts.title: Basic meanings of out in phrasal verbs
Other meanings of out in phrasal verbs

items.pattern: kick sb out (of sth) · with an object, separable: kick out the troublemakers / kick them out, never kick out them · informal; also throw sb out · subjects: a landlord, a school, a club, your parents
items.meaning: force someone to leave a place, a school, a job or a group
items.example: Her parents threatened to **kick her out** if she didn't find a job.
more: The bouncers **kicked out** two men who had started a fight.
She was **kicked out of** the choir for missing too many rehearsals.
items.watchOut: Займенник стоїть між дієсловом і out: kick him out, не kick out him. Звідки — out of: kicked out of school. Це розмовне слово; в офіційному листі — expel (зі школи), evict (з житла), dismiss (з роботи).

items.pattern: sb wants out (of sth) · intransitive, no to: I want out · informal · out of a job, a deal, a contract, a relationship
items.meaning: want to leave a situation or an arrangement and stop being part of it
items.example: The band isn't going anywhere, and I've had enough. I **want out**.
more: Halfway through the building work, our builder said he **wanted out** of the contract.
If you **want out** of your gym membership, you have to give a month's notice.
items.watchOut: Want out — без to і без go. I want to go out — це «хочу кудись піти (погуляти, розважитися)», зовсім інше значення.

items.pattern: Count me / us out (of sth)! · informal reply; the pronoun goes in the middle · opposite: Count me in! · formal: exclude sb
items.meaning: don't include me; I won't take part
items.example: A ten-mile walk in the rain? **Count me out**!
more: If you're all going to that karaoke bar, **count me out**. I can't sing.
You can **count us out** of the quiz night this year; we're away that weekend.
items.watchOut: «Без мене, я пас» — Count me out!, «я з вами» — Count me in! Without me! — калька, так не відповідають. Займенник посередині: count us out, не count out us.

items.pattern: sth juts out (over / into / from sth) · intransitive · subjects: a rock, a roof, a balcony, a pier, a chin · formal: protrude
items.meaning: stick out beyond the edge or the surface of what is around it
items.example: Mind your head: a sharp rock **juts out** from the cave wall just here.
more: In the old town, the upper floors **jut out** over the street, so the houses almost touch.
His chin **juts out** when he's being stubborn.
items.watchOut: Jut out — про те, що постійно виступає за край: скелі, дахи, балкони, миси, підборіддя. Висунути язик чи руку — stick out, не jut out. Вимова: /dʒʌt/, голосний як у but, не «джут».

items.pattern: pick sb/sth out (from sth) · with an object, separable: pick out the best ones / pick the best ones out / pick them out · formal: select
items.meaning: choose one or a few from a larger group, carefully
items.example: Let your grandmother **pick out** the wallpaper; it's her bedroom, after all.
more: He **picked out** a tie to go with his new suit.
The teacher **picked out** three of the best essays to read aloud.
items.watchOut: Pick out — вибрати з багатьох; pick up — підняти, забрати (дитину зі школи). Займенник посередині: pick it out, не pick out it.

items.pattern: spread sth out (on / over sth) · with an object, separable: spread out the map / spread the map out / spread it out · spread – spread – spread
items.meaning: open or lay things on a surface so that they cover it and are not in a pile
items.example: We **spread out** a picnic blanket in the shade and unpacked the food.
more: Let's **spread out** all the holiday photos on the table and choose the best ones.
She **spread out** her notes across the kitchen floor the night before the exam.
items.watchOut: Форми однакові: spread – spread – spread, «spreaded» не буває. Без out spread часто означає «намазати»: spread butter on toast.

items.pattern: share sth out (among / between people) · with an object, separable: share out the sweets / share them out · formal: distribute
items.meaning: divide something and give a part to each person in a group
items.example: Grandma always **shares out** the leftover cake so that everyone takes some home.
more: We **shared out** the cost of the petrol between the four of us.
The teacher **shared out** the crayons so that every table had some.
items.watchOut: Share sth with sb — поділитися з кимось (дати частину свого). Share sth out among / between — розділити між усіма: shared out among the children.

items.pattern: a fire / a candle / a light goes out · intransitive · went out, has gone out
items.meaning: (of a fire, a flame or a light) stop burning or shining
items.example: The fire had **gone out** overnight, and the cottage was freezing.
more: The street lights **go out** at midnight to save energy.
Strike another match. This one has **gone out**.
items.watchOut: Вогонь згас — the fire went out. Про вогонь і свічку не кажуть turned off (так вимикають прилад) чи went off (go off — вибухнути, задзвонити про будильник, зіпсуватися про їжу). Про світло можна і the lights went out, і the lights went off. Не плутай з go out — «піти кудись розважитися».

items.pattern: clean sb out · informal · with an object, separable: clean out a whole family / clean them out · subjects: burglars, thieves; also a big expense: the holiday cleaned me out
items.meaning: steal or take everything someone has, including all their money
items.example: Thieves broke into our holiday flat and **cleaned us out**: passports, cash, even the phone chargers.
more: The car repairs **cleaned me out**, so I can't afford a holiday this year.
A pickpocket on the tram **cleaned her out** before she even noticed.
items.watchOut: Не плутай: clean out a cupboard / the garage — вичистити, розібрати. А коли об'єкт — людина, clean sb out — обчистити. Займенник посередині: cleaned us out.

items.pattern: test sth out (on sb) · with an object, separable: test out a new idea / test it out · in real conditions, with real users · close to try sth out
items.meaning: try something in a real situation to see how well it works or what people think of it
items.uk: випробувати на практиці, перевірити в дії
items.example: Before our camping trip, we **tested** the new tent **out** in the back garden.
more: The school is **testing out** a four-day week with one class this term.
The bakery **tested out** three new kinds of bread on its regular customers.
items.watchOut: Out підкреслює: перевіряють у справжніх умовах, а не в лабораторії. Займенник посередині: test it out, не test out it.

items.pattern: drop out (of sth) · intransitive · of a race, a course, university, a competition, a trip · noun: a dropout
items.meaning: stop taking part in something before the end, or decide not to do something you had planned to do
items.uk: вибути, зійти з дистанції; кинути (навчання); відмовитися від участі
items.example: Two days before the wedding, the photographer **dropped out**, and we had to find someone else.
more: She hurt her knee and had to **drop out** of the tennis tournament.
Lots of people join the gym in January and **drop out** by March.
items.watchOut: Кинути навчання — drop out of school / university (з of). Drop off — задрімати або висадити когось з машини. Той, хто кинув навчання, — a dropout.

items.pattern: lash out (at sb/sth) · intransitive; the person or thing comes after at · at critics, the government, your family · sudden and angry · neutral: criticise angrily
items.meaning: suddenly and angrily criticise someone or something
items.uk: накинутися (на когось) з критикою, різко напасти
items.example: Dad **lashed out at** the waiter, which wasn't fair: the kitchen was to blame.
more: The singer **lashed out at** critics who had called her new album boring.
When she's stressed, she tends to **lash out at** whoever is nearest.
items.watchOut: Накинутися НА когось — lash out AT sb, не on. Lash out on sth (брит., розм.) — зовсім інше: розщедритися, витратити купу грошей. Звучить різко: це не просто «покритикувати».

items.pattern: yell out (sth) · with or without an object; separable: yell out sb's name / yell it out · informal; also shout out, call out
items.meaning: suddenly shout something loudly, often to get someone's attention
items.example: From the back of the hall, someone **yelled out**, 'We can't hear you!'
more: As the train pulled away, Grandad **yelled out** something we couldn't hear.
If you need help with the shopping bags, just **yell out**.
items.watchOut: Yell out — вигукнути, щоб тебе почули. Yell at sb — кричати на когось, сварити. Гукнути комусь, не сварячись, — yell to sb.

items.pattern: draw sth out · with an object, separable: draw out a meeting / draw it out · objects: a meeting, a discussion, a goodbye, a court case · adjective: (long-)drawn-out
items.meaning: make something last longer than it needs to
items.example: The lawyers **drew out** the case for nearly two years.
more: She **drew out** the story to keep us guessing until the very end.
Nobody likes a **drawn-out** goodbye at the airport.
items.watchOut: «Затягувати» — draw out (або drag out), не pull out (вийти з угоди, виїхати) і не delay (відкласти, затримати початок). Прикметник: a long, drawn-out process.

items.pattern: sort sth out · with an object, separable: sort out the problem / sort the problem out / sort it out, never sort out it · objects: a problem, a mess, a misunderstanding, a cupboard · formal: resolve
items.meaning: solve a problem, or put something messy in order
items.example: We need to **sort out** who's driving to the wedding.
more: This weekend I'm finally going to **sort out** the cupboard under the stairs.
My sister and her husband have **sorted out** their differences and are talking again.
items.watchOut: Займенник — посередині: sort it out, не sort out it. «Розібратися з проблемою» — sort out the problem, без with.

warmup.uk: Поки ми спали, вогонь у каміні згас.
warmup.q: While we were asleep, the log fire ___.
warmup.explain: Вогонь, свічка, світло гаснуть — go out. Turn off — вимкнути прилад; go off — вибухнути, задзвонити (про будильник).

warmup.uk: Знову рибалка о п'ятій ранку? Я пас!
warmup.q: Fishing at five in the morning again? ___!
warmup.explain: «Без мене, я пас» — Count me out! Протилежне — Count me in!

warmup.uk: Не хвилюйся, я з цим розберуся.
warmup.explain: Займенник — між дієсловом і out: sort it out. «Розібратися з» — без with.

warmup.uk: З мене досить. Я хочу вийти з цієї угоди.
warmup.q: I've had enough. I ___ of this deal.
warmup.explain: Want out (of sth) — хотіти вийти зі справи, угоди, стосунків. I want to go out — «хочу кудись піти розважитися».

warmup.uk: Якщо ми не перестанемо балакати, нас виженуть з бібліотеки.
warmup.q: If we don't stop talking, they'll ___ of the library.
warmup.explain: Kick sb out — вигнати; займенник посередині: kick us out. Throw away — викинути річ на смітник.
Кинути навчання — drop out of school / university. Drop off — задрімати або висадити когось з машини.

warmup.uk: Втомлена після нічної зміни, вона накинулася на дітей через розкидані іграшки.
warmup.q: Tired after the night shift, she ___ the children for leaving toys everywhere.
warmup.explain: Накинутися на когось зі злою критикою — lash out AT sb. Lash out on sth (розм.) — розщедритися, витратити купу грошей.

warmup.uk: Не затягуй прощання, таксі вже чекає.
warmup.q: Don't ___ the goodbyes. The taxi's already here.
warmup.explain: Затягувати щось — draw sth out (або drag sth out). Pull out — вийти з угоди, виїхати; draw on — спиратися на щось (досвід, запаси).

A.q: Sam was so rude to the other guests that the hotel manager ___.
A.explain: Kick sb out — вигнати. Count sb out — не рахувати когось учасником; pick sb out — вибрати з-поміж інших.

A.q: If you're all going clubbing tonight, ___. I need my sleep.
A.explain: Count me out — «без мене». Count me in — «я з вами»; count on me — «можеш на мене покластися».

A.q: Mum opened a box of chocolates and ___ so that we all got the same number.
A.explain: Share sth out — поділити між усіма порівну; займенник посередині: shared them out. Pick out — вибрати.

B.q: Our little fire ___ in the rain, and we had no matches to light it again.
B.explain: Go out — згаснути. Go off — вибухнути, задзвонити; drop out — вибути, кинути щось.

B.q: Joe ___ at his brother for borrowing his car without asking.
B.explain: Lash out at sb — накинутися на когось зі злою критикою. Drop out — вибути; sort out — розібратися.

B.q: We'd better ___ this misunderstanding before it gets any worse.
B.explain: Sort out — розібратися, владнати. Draw out — затягувати; test out — випробувати.

example.title: Never again
example.uk:
Минулого літа ми вшістьох поїхали з наметами на озеро. Першого вечора ми розстелили спальники просто неба, а Мія поділила між усіма бутерброди. Лео хотів випробувати свою нову туристичну плитку, але вона гасла кожні п'ять хвилин.

Наступного ранку виявилося, що нас хтось обчистив: їжа, телефони, навіть взуття. Лео накинувся на Бена за те, що той лишив намет відкритим, а Бен сказав, що хоче покинути похід, і поїхав додому.

Решта з нас розібралася з тим, що лишилося, і вибрала тихе місце для риболовлі. Коли Мія впіймала величезну рибу, вона закричала так голосно, що її почуло все озеро. Знову в похід наступного року? Я пас!
example.en:
Last summer six of us went camping by a lake. On the first evening we [[spread out|a6]] our sleeping bags under the stars, and Mia [[shared out|a7]] the sandwiches. Leo wanted to [[test out|b3]] his new camping stove, but it [[went out|b1]] every five minutes.

The next morning we found that someone had [[cleaned us out|b2]]: food, phones, even our shoes. Leo [[lashed out at|b5]] Ben for leaving the tent open, and Ben said he [[wanted out|a2]] and went home.

The rest of us [[sorted out|b8]] what was left and [[picked out|a5]] a quiet spot for fishing. When Mia caught a huge fish, she [[yelled out|b6]] so loudly that the whole lake heard her. Camping again next year? [[Count me out|a3]]!
